theorems.statement: ∀ (m d P : ℕ) (B B' : Set (Euclid d)) (G : Euclid d → Euclid P) (J : Euclid d → ℝ) (p : Euclid d → Prop), MeasurableSet B → MeasurableSet B' → B' ⊆ B → ContinuousOn G B → InjOn G B → (∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ w in G '' B, g w ∂μHE[m] = ∫⁻ v in B, ENNReal.ofReal (J v) * g (G v) ∂μHE[m]) → (∀ᵐ v ∂(μHE[m].restrict B), p v) → ∀ᵐ w ∂(μHE[m].restrict (G '' B')), ∃ v ∈ B', G v = w ∧ p v
